articles.title: Journal: the numbers behind it
articles.brief: Why contemporaneous notes matter in disputes — records made at the time carry more weight than memory; source: legal-aid record-keeping guidance.

articles.title: Journal: what it does and how to use it
articles.brief: What the Journal is — free-form dated notes about conversations, incidents, and requests. Example: after a call with the landlord, the tenant logs what was said while it's fresh.
